PLAN "12-Week Strength Program Phased Around Cycle and Flare Windows"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "increase full-body strength while accommodating cycle and flare windows"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation and Cycle Sync (Weeks 1-4)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower Body Strength A":
        warmup:
          walking 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 4 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Upper Body Strength A":
        warmup:
          rowing 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 4 minutes
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full Body Strength B":
        warmup:
          cycling 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x4 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lunge 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          back_extension 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 4 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower Body Strength A+":
        warmup:
          walking 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x35 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 4 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Upper Body Strength A+":
        warmup:
          rowing 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x4 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 4x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 4 minutes
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full Body Strength B+":
        warmup:
          cycling 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x3 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          dumbbell_press 4x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lunge 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          back_extension 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 4 minutes
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower Body Strength A (Follicular Peak)":
        warmup:
          rowing 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x40 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 4 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Upper Body Strength A (Follicular Peak)":
        warmup:
          cycling 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          barbell_row 5x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 4x4 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          face_pull 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 4 minutes
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full Body Strength B (Follicular Peak)":
        warmup:
          rowing 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x3 rpe 8 rest 210 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          back_extension 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 4 minutes
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Deload (Late Luteal)":
        warmup:
          walking 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 4 minutes
      DAY Thursday training 40m "Deload Accessory":
        warmup:
          cycling 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 4 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2: Build Around First Flare Window (Weeks 5-8)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Strength Rebuild A (Early Follicular)":
        warmup:
          rowing 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x4 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          bench_press 4x4 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds

          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 4 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Strength Rebuild B":
        warmup:
          cycling 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:

          overhead_press 4x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lunge 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          back_extension 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 4 minutes
      DAY Friday training 50m "Hypertrophy Support":
        warmup:
          rowing 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 4x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 4x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x35 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 4 minutes
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Strength A (Ovulatory Peak)":
        warmup:

          squat 5x3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          bench_press 5x3 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds

        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 4 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Strength B (Ovulatory Peak)":
        warmup:
          rowing 8 minutes

          deadlift 4x3 rpe 8 rest 210 seconds
          overhead_press 4x4 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          back_extension 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 4 minutes
      DAY Friday training 50m "Accessory Strength":
        warmup:
          cycling 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x40 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 4 minutes
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Pre-Flare Taper":
        warmup:
          walking 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x4 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 3x4 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 2x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 4 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Pre-Flare Accessories":
        warmup:
          cycling 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 4 minutes
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Flare-Safe Session 1 (No HIIT/Jump/Valsalva)":
        warmup:
          walking 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 4 minutes
      DAY Thursday training 35m "Flare-Safe Session 2 (Gentle Mobility/Strength)":
        warmup:
          walking 8 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          split_squat 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 2x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 4 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3: Build Around Second Flare Window (Weeks 9-12)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Strength Return A (Early Follicular)":

          rowing 8 minutes
